name: Desert Lark
extract: The desert lark (Ammomanes deserti) breeds in deserts and semi-deserts from Morocco to western India.  It has a very wide distribution and faces no obvious threats, and surveys have shown that it is slowly increasing in numbers as it expands its range. The International Union for Conservation of Nature has rated its conservation status as being of "least concern".
